summary: MCP Subactor Tools and SUMD Source Adapter

delivery.outcome: Expose Subactor envelope and healing tools over MCP and urirun, and implement SUMD source adapter with full test coverage.
nonGoals: Break existing comparator or adapter contracts.
Mutate third-party repositories without a bound grant.

architecture.decision: Add SUMDAdapter to src/data2dsl_adapters.py, extend Data2DslSkill and MCP handlers in src/data2dsl_skill.py with data2dsl_validate_envelope and data2dsl_simulate_healing, and add tests in tests/test_sumd_adapter.py and tests/test_skill.py.
architecture.rollback: Revert src/data2dsl_adapters.py, src/data2dsl_skill.py, tests/test_sumd_adapter.py, and tests/test_skill.py.

validation.evidence: SUMD adapter and MCP skill tool tests pass.
